styles.name: Anime
styles.description: Saturated skies, cel-shaded shapes, speed lines, dramatic character-silhouette reveals, sakura/sparkle particles, title slams.
styles.camera: fast pushes, impact frames, speed-line zooms

styles.name: Apple-style product ad
styles.description: Hero-product cinematography on black or white: dramatic rim light, slow orbits, oversized confident headlines, one line of copy at a time.
styles.camera: slow orbit / push on the hero, shallow depth (rack focus), light sweeps
assets: hero product with gradient rim light
do: gradient text for the key word

styles.name: Arcade
styles.description: Cabinet energy: attract-mode flashes, INSERT COIN blink, high-score tables, neon marquee colours, CRT glow.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.description: White linework on blueprint blue, construction lines, dimensions, title block; lines draw on precisely.
styles.camera: top-down pans along drawings; zoom into details

styles.name: Children's illustration
styles.description: Round friendly shapes, bright soft colours, bouncy timing, big rounded type, sparkles and smiles.

styles.name: Cinematic trailer
styles.description: Letterboxed, high contrast, teal/orange grade, huge condensed titles on black between shots, braams and silence.
styles.camera: slow push-ins, dramatic reveals, a shake on impacts
do: title cards on black between beats

styles.name: Clean UI
styles.description: Soft light UI: white cards, subtle shadows, one brand colour, crisp system type; motion follows interaction.
styles.camera: zoom into the part of the UI being used; follow the cursor

styles.name: Comic book
styles.description: Panels, bold ink outlines, halftone dots, action lines, SFX lettering (POW!), primary colours.

styles.name: Corporate
styles.description: Trustworthy and clear: navy + bright blue, clean sans, structured grids, icons and data, calm confident pacing.
styles.camera: gentle pans across grids, no shake

styles.name: CRT
styles.description: Curved-glass monitor: scanlines, phosphor glow, flicker, bezel vignette; green or amber terminal type.

styles.name: Cyberpunk
styles.description: Neon magenta/cyan on near-black, rain, signage, glow, scanlines, synth pulse; dense layered city depth.
styles.camera: push through layered skyline; parallax signs; rain streaks

styles.name: Dark atmospheric
styles.description: Low-key lighting, fog, bokeh and slow reveals; mood over information.
styles.camera: slow drift, rack focus between layers

styles.name: Data visualization
styles.description: Chart-first: axes, gridlines, lines that draw, highlighted series, annotations; dark analytical canvas.

styles.name: Digital / Tech
styles.description: Nodes, networks, code and data flows on dark blue; precise type; glowing connections.
styles.camera: fly through node networks; zoom into code

styles.name: Documentary
styles.description: Archival credibility: lower thirds, dates, maps, captions, film grain, Ken Burns moves on stills.
styles.camera: Ken Burns pans/zooms on stills, map fly-ins

styles.name: Documentary map
styles.description: Parchment/dark maps, dotted landmass, animated routes, pins, dates and labels; camera flies between places.

styles.name: Doodle
styles.description: Notebook doodles: marker outlines, stickers, arrows, stars, playful bouncing icons on lined paper.

styles.name: Editorial
styles.description: Magazine layouts in motion: big serif headlines, italic accents, columns, rules, photo-like blocks, confident asymmetry.
styles.camera: slow pans across layouts; cut on type

styles.name: 8-bit
styles.description: NES-era: tiny palette, big chunky pixels, black background, blink text, chiptune bleeps.

styles.name: 80s
styles.description: Neon pinks and teals, chrome type, laser grids, memphis shapes, VHS-ready saturation.

styles.name: Experimental
styles.description: Rule-breaking type and composition: extreme scale, overlaps, distortion, unexpected cuts and colour clashes.

styles.name: Fantasy cinematic
styles.description: Warm golds and deep greens, ornate serif titles, embers and god-rays, mist, heroic slow reveals.

styles.name: Futuristic HUD
styles.description: Thin cyan linework, rings, tick marks, data readouts, scanning motions; everything is an instrument.

styles.name: Generative
styles.description: Rule-based systems in motion: flow fields, recursive shapes, noise-driven lines; the system is the subject.

styles.name: Geometric
styles.description: Primitive shapes with strict ratios: circles, squares, triangles build, rotate and lock into grids; bold flat colour.

styles.name: Glitch
styles.description: Broken signal as aesthetic: RGB separation, slice displacement, pixel sorting bars, harsh digital colour, stutter cuts.

styles.name: Gradient / abstract
styles.description: Big soft mesh gradients drifting, grain, huge type knocked out of colour; mood-driven.

styles.name: Hand-drawn
styles.description: Wobbly ink lines drawn on, paper texture, marker fills slightly off-register, handwritten labels.

styles.name: Holographic
styles.description: Iridescent gradients, translucent layers, light refraction, soft glow and floating glass panels.

styles.name: Horror
styles.description: Mostly darkness; cold desaturated greens; one red; flicker, long silences and sudden stingers; hide more than you show.
styles.camera: creeping pushes, slow handheld, sudden shake on stingers

styles.name: Infographic
styles.description: Clear data storytelling: big numbers, icons, bars/rings that build, consistent visual grammar, one insight per beat.
styles.camera: slide between data panels; zoom into the number that matters

styles.name: Liquid
styles.description: Blobby morphing shapes, gooey merges, glossy highlights, fluid transitions between states.

styles.name: Premium / Luxury
styles.description: Slow, elegant, restrained: deep blacks or ivory, gold hairlines, serif display type with wide tracking, light glints.
styles.camera: slow dolly and push, macro details, light sweeps across metal

styles.name: Manga
styles.description: Black & white ink, screentones, speed lines, dramatic close-ups, vertical Japanese-style panels.

styles.name: Minimal
styles.description: Reduction as the idea: one subject, one message per shot, huge negative space, a single accent colour.
styles.camera: static or very slow push; no shake
do: left-aligned or centred grid, generous margins

styles.name: 90s
styles.description: Loud collage: xerox textures, stickers, zine type, stamped labels, crooked frames, MTV-style bumpers.
styles.camera: crooked cuts, dutch angles, snap zooms

styles.name: Organic
styles.description: Leaves, growth, earthy palette, curves and breathing motion; things grow rather than appear.

styles.name: Paper cutout
styles.description: Layered paper sheets with soft drop shadows, visible texture, slight wobble, stepped stop-motion timing.

styles.name: Particle-based
styles.description: Thousands of points form, scatter and re-form; the subject is made of particles; glowing on dark.

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.description: Crisp integer grid, limited palette, pixel font, stepped animation, dithering; no soft edges.

styles.name: Retro-futurism
styles.description: The future as the past imagined it: chrome sunsets, grid floors, star-streaks, italic chrome type, synth pulse.
styles.camera: glide over the grid floor toward the sun

styles.name: Startup / SaaS
styles.description: Bright gradients, floating UI cards, cursor-driven demos, snappy confident motion, big benefit headlines.
styles.camera: quick pushes onto UI, subtle parallax of stacked cards

styles.name: Scientific
styles.description: Clean lab aesthetic: molecules, cells, equations, labelled diagrams, calm educational pacing.

styles.name: Sci-fi cinematic
styles.description: Vast scale, cold blues with a hot accent, starfields, planets, HUD fragments, slow majestic camera.
styles.camera: slow dolly through space; warp on transitions

styles.name: 16-bit
styles.description: SNES-era: richer ramps, parallax layers, mode-7 floors, bold pixel logos.

styles.name: Stop-motion simulation
styles.description: 12 fps stepped motion, subtle per-frame jitter of every object, tactile materials and soft light.

styles.name: Technical
styles.description: Precise linework, callouts with leader lines, exploded parts, measurement labels, neutral greys + one signal colour.
styles.camera: orthographic moves; precise zoom into parts

styles.name: Timeline
styles.description: Horizontal/vertical time axis that draws on; years as big numerals; events pop at their date; camera tracks along.

styles.name: VHS
styles.description: Camcorder tape: chroma bleed, tracking bands, timestamp, soft focus, jittery lines, washed colours.

styles.name: Whiteboard
styles.description: Marker drawings appear stroke-by-stroke on white, handwritten labels, arrows, a hand/pen implied.
styles.camera: pan along the board as drawings accumulate

styles.name: Y2K
styles.description: Glossy bubbles, chrome, silver gradients, aqua highlights, blobby shapes, sparkle stars, optimistic tech.
